originality.rationale: PASS, best of knowledge, subject to an explicit close neighbor. Antolin Camarena--Carnero Bravo 2024 Theorem3.17/3.18/Question3.19 bounds possible homology dimensions for C_(3r+2) x Kn and asks whether torsion is absent, but does NOT give integral C8 x K4 ranks or homotopy decomposition. A 2026-10-11 indexed C7 x K4 theorem gives 3 S3 plus 6 S4; the equal multiplicities shifted by one are notable but the record has a different graph and no demonstrated general suspension/reduction from C7 to C8. The published paper explicitly lists C8 x K3 rather than this C8 x K4. New computation is a separate complete finite case, though a not-yet-recognized recurrence could imply it.
residual_risks: Published C7 x K4 has precisely the same sphere multiplicities one dimension lower; a currently unproved or unrecognized suspension/reduction could cover the C8 x K4 result.

A published 2019 graph-perturbation suspension theorem was read in original full text: its local replacement has +4 vertices and +6 edges, whereas C7xK4 to C8xK4 has +4 vertices and +12 edges. The exact theorem does not directly cover the transition; a different hidden relation remains possible.
The result is a fixed 32-vertex complex only; no family-wide absence of Moore-space torsion is proved.

final_claim: The independence complex of the 32-vertex categorical graph C8 x K4 is homotopy equivalent over the integers to a wedge of 3 four-spheres and 6 five-spheres, hence its only reduced integral homology is Z^3 in degree4 and Z^6 in degree5 with no torsion.
